title: Chapter 601
paragraphs: Chapter 601
Episode 156. Purification of Chaos (5)
'Did it just smile?'
I clearly saw it. Despite having a face entirely different from a human, it had a distinctly villainous expression.
However, there was no time to contemplate about such a creature. All the power he had honed over his lifetime disappeared in an instant.
The aura and magical power that were close to the 10th rank were not felt at all. As if they never existed in the first place.
"Your sense of loss must be great, Brother Jin. However, you can reclaim it from the chaos."
Of course, it's not as easy as it sounds.
However, instead of despairing, Jin lifted his head and stared at the chaos.
'Anyway, there's no other choice.'
Upon closer consideration, the situation wasn't that bad. If I had arrived at Lafrarosa just a bit later, I would've been victimized by that chaotic monster without even understanding why.
Although I've lost my aura and magical power, most of the formidable foes Jin had fought until now possessed power much stronger than that.
Fighting against stronger opponents and somehow seizing victory was one of the things Jin did best.
The chaos entity, it was now cautiously observing Ban's reactions with a smile gone from its face.
'It's really scared of the Tushin brothers. It's revealing all that while thoughtlessly rolling its eyes.'
Fear is a weakness. In that sense, to Jin's eyes, chaos looked very immature. It wasn't just chaos that recognized Jin as Ban's weakness.
"Tushin brothers. This situation is not training, but clearly purification, right?"
"That's right. I'm not lying to train you. Really, neither I nor the other brothers can do anything in your stead."
"Yes, I didn't ask because I thought the Tushin brothers deceived me for training."
"Then?"
"Since it's not training, I was wondering if I could get help from the brothers in an emergency."
Ban nodded his head.
"Of course, it's possible."
Swish...
The bands of the extraction assist device tied to Jin's head were released. Jin, slowly getting up, drew out Siegmund.
Habits are scary.
He naturally tried to wrap the sword with his aura, but there was no response. Even the power of aura that always assisted his physique was gone, so Siegmund felt heavy.
At this point, the chaos revealed its ridicule once again.
"In other words, it means that I will never die fighting with it."
The Demon King's tribe couldn't directly attack the chaos, but they could always rescue Jin if he was in danger.
"Of course, and there won't be any possibility of becoming disabled either."
"Also, if it harms you beyond recovery. The brothers will certainly seek revenge."

"The fight between Brother Jin and it will always involve my direct participation, so there won't be such an unfortunate incident. However, if it kills you in a way that we can't intervene, then we will certainly seek revenge."
The smirk on the chaos's face, which was subtly there, hardened.
'It has the intelligence to understand words, but only the reasoning ability to barely see an inch ahead. It keeps revealing its shallow intentions.'

I don't know exactly how much power it has yet, but the energy it stole from me alone should be of a level comparable to the 10th rank. Plus, with the energy of chaos, it's highly likely it would've been a formidable opponent even before I lost my power.
Its low intelligence was somewhat a relief to Jin.
"Do you want to start fighting right now?"
"Yes, Tushin brothers."
As Jin slowly approached, the chaos also spread its wings and stood up. Its shadow covered Jin and Ban.
'The intimidation... is no joke.'
The feeling was more intense as I had lost my power. I was even convinced that it could end me just by lifting its front leg and crushing me like a bug.

A hollow laughter came out from the helplessness that made my teeth chatter. The martial prowess, which had been exercised against the infinite faces of the Demon King's warriors until just 30 minutes ago, was completely gone.
However, the confrontation between Jin and it was going somewhat strangely.
The closer Jin approached, the more it stepped back. Of course, it wasn't because it was scared of fighting Jin.
It was because Ban was standing about five steps behind Jin, preparing for any contingencies.
'So this is how it feels to fight with someone at your back.'
Ban's two eyes were glaring fiercely at the chaos. The look in his eyes said, 'Sit still, return Brother Jin's power, and just die.'
Jin was frustrated with the chaos that was only increasing the distance, and for the chaos, it was mortifying.
"Hmm."
Eventually, Jin started the charge first. Chaos tried to widen the distance faster in response, but upon seeing Ban's blazing eyes, it could neither do this nor that.
And once again, Jin was shocked by how 'slow' he was. His body, without the assistance of aura, was barely at the level of a lower-class warrior.
Regardless, Jin swung his sword with all his might.
Unable to leap up to the chaos's head, the striking point had to be its front leg. Putting all his strength into his stomach, the downward strike he made while shouting at the top of his lungs...
Neither made a sound of a metallic clang, nor a thud, nor a squish, but a tiny, babyish "pong-!" sound, once again crumbling Jin's spirit.
And that wasn't the end of it.
Despite the fact that Jin had attacked, he was flung backward by the repelling force of the protective shield that it had reflexively put up.
"Cough!"
Surprisingly, or regrettably.
It was a full day later when Jin, who had been flung back, opened his eyes. It felt to Jin as if he had just blinked once.
As soon as he woke up, a sigh escaped from him naturally.
Jin was able to quickly understand the situation from the worried faces of his brothers looking down at him.
"Brother Jin! You're awake. Are you okay?"
"Ah, don't move your body yet. Your bones haven't fully healed."
"Bones? Did my bones break?"
"About seventeen places... With your strong body, they should heal quickly, but it will take some time now."

Thanks to the extreme training of his blessed muscles and bones, he only suffered bone and organ damage. If it had been another lower-class warrior, they would have died instantly from the recoil of chaos.
For Jin, it was a series of shocks.
'Even so... I didn't even realize the moment I fainted? Me?'
Memories of countless battles that he had won with difficulty, but ultimately, flashed through Jin's mind.
He remembered enduring to the end with his willpower in any situation, but such a humiliating defeat!
"How is it doing?"
"No, never mind. I asked a clear question."
Chaos was sprawled out sleeping in the middle of the training ground. It had only received a shock that wouldn't even be equivalent to a single hair falling out if compared to a human.
'This isn't a situation that can be solved by mental strength or will.'
Just as an ant can't beat a tiger no matter how hard it tries, there was almost that much of a gap between Jin and chaos right now.
Lying down, he clenched and unclenched his fist, checking the condition of his body once more.
He felt a faint presence of aura and magic power. It took quite a while to even realize that, as the control that could move even a single hair as he wished had disappeared.
'Do I have to build up energy from scratch to deal with it? No, there's no answer in three years if I do that.'
It's a path he has taken before, so he can reach it faster than before. But three years is far from enough.
Just as he was about to ponder, the door opened and Ban walked in.
"Tushin brothers."
Unlike Jin, who looked gloomy and serious, she had a faint smile on her lips.
"I didn't know Brother Jin could look so foolish."
"I was made a fool of. It's embarrassing."
"That's not what I meant."
Unable to hold it in, Ban let out a chuckle.
Jin didn't mind if she was mocking him. Rather, he was relieved to see a simple side of her that was rarely seen among the absolutes.
'Well, since Ban is immune to demonization, does she not become desolate inside even when reaching the extreme, like father or Ron?'
Ban turned her gaze to the Bradamante placed next to Jin.
"It was strange from the moment you naturally chose Sigmund instead of Bradamante before you attacked it. It seemed like the insightful Brother Jin was missing something too simple."
"What do you mean... oh, you don't mean?"
"Yes. What Brother Jin lost was just aura and magic power. It means that the spirit power you possess is entirely intact."
Jin's face flushed instantly. The other celestial brothers either held back their laughter or failed to, making Jin even more embarrassed.
Overwhelmed by the loss of his aura and magic power, he had completely forgotten about his spirit power.
"I was so stupid. How could I forget this!?"
"I thought you were pretending to lose even your spirit power to strike at its weaknesses as always."
A lump of spirit power formed in the lying Jin's hand. Jin also saw it and let out a bitter laugh.
"If I had fought with a spirit sword...."
"The result would have been the same, but the process would have been different."
"As soon as I recover, I will try again. I didn't even fully understand its overall power in this fight."
"That's right. And although other brothers can't see it, Brother Jin will be able to feel the power it stole."
The key was to retrieve those powers while fighting. As Jin regained his original strength, naturally, it would gradually weaken.
The recovery ended five days later. Jin again found Chaos lying in the training ground with his brothers and drew his sword.
It looked as if it was reluctantly raising its head as if Jin was very tired.
There
were two reasons why it was so relaxed.
First, Jin was ridiculously weak, and second, the Celestials did not retaliate even after it unintentionally hurt Jin.
Therefore, Chaos planned to keep delaying its extinction by making Jin faint every time he attacked.
[Haaaaam.]
Chaos yawned languidly, then went back to sleep with its protective shield.
'Does it not know I have spirit power, or does it know but not see it as a threat.'
Either way, it was something to be verified.
Jin strode towards it and struck down hard on the protective shield with Bradamante, covered in spirit power.
[Kyak!]
As soon as the spirit power touched the protective shield, it sat up with a start and blinked its eyes.
